articles.title: NASA’s IXPE Gets Fresh Look at Supernova
articles.summary: NASA’s IXPE (Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer) mission has taken a new observation of a supernova, RCW 86, seen here in an image released on March 24, 2026. articles.title: Live Coverage: SpaceX to launch batch of Starlink satellites from the West Coast
articles.summary: Liftoff of the Starlink 17-17 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base, in California is scheduled during a launch window that opens at 4:03 p.m. PDT (7:03 p.m. EDT / 2303 UTC).

articles.title: Satlantis earnings grow alongside demand for Earth-observation satellites
articles.summary:
WASHINGTON – Satlantis reported revenues of 47.8 million euros ($56.4 million) in 2025, with more than 50% of the Spanish company’s income derived from small-satellite sales and operations.
